title: Mask My File
hero: Spot private details, decide exactly what to black out, and share a verified copy while the context people need stays intact.
formatsTitle: A single private workflow for every file
formatsText: Preview images and PDFs at full width, zoom up to 5× and draw exact areas by hand. Search every match across Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV and RTF, then choose stars, partial masks, placeholders, pseudonyms or removal. Metadata is stripped wherever the format allows.
verifyText: Mask My File writes a fresh copy, reopens it and confirms the protected file is still valid before it shows Private Ready. Your original stays exactly as it was.
batchText: Give each file its own preview and manual selections, search the same private text right across the set, then export every verified copy in one go.
supportTitle: Protect a file in three clear steps
supportIntro: Turn to Mask My File before sending a tenancy application, an NHS letter, a client file, a screenshot or anything carrying details other people do not need to see.
step1: Choose a photo, PDF, document, structured-data file or pasted text. Scanning begins locally on your device straight away.
step2: Review every finding, add anything that was missed or draw an exact area, then pick a protection style the file type supports.
step3: Create the protected copy and share it only once Private Ready confirms the new output reopened and passed its check.
faqText: It means the newly protected copy was rendered, reopened and checked for a valid file structure. It never replaces your own final review before you share.
contactText: Email hourstag.app@gmail.com with your device model, iOS version, file type and a brief note about what you were doing.
privacyIntro: Mask My File is built to protect files without ever collecting them. No account is needed, and the app carries no advertising, tracking, analytics or content-upload service.
deviceText: Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine scan the content you choose locally. Masking, redaction, metadata removal, export and verification all run on the device as well.
faceText: Face detection only marks image regions for you to review. Mask My File never identifies people, builds a biometric or identity template, uploads face data, shares it or keeps separate face data.
storeTitle: Purchases are the only network call
storeText: Apple processes the optional lifetime purchase and restore through StoreKit. Mask My File uses no VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter or network routing whatsoever.
retentionText: Originals are never overwritten. Temporary workspace files, saved projects, Placeholder Vault mappings and Private Session data remain only as each feature explains. Delete them in the app or remove the app to wipe its local container.
